fslog.empty: Chat is empty — nothing to save.
fslog.wait: Wait %s s before the next upload.
fslog.open: Open the log in your browser
fslog.error.offline: the log server is unavailable right now, try later
fslog.view.title: Chat log
fslog.view.empty: Chat is empty — new messages appear after “Refresh”.
fslog.view.upload.hint: Send the whole snapshot from this window to fspirat.xyz and get a link (search does not affect the upload). Nothing is sent until you press it.
fslog.view.refresh.hint: Take a fresh snapshot of the chat. Until then, new messages stay out of this view and out of the upload.
fslog.view.busy: The previous log is still uploading — please wait.
fslog.view.hint: View only: the log goes to the site only when you press “Upload to site”.
fslog.view.search.tip: Search message text, case-insensitive. Ctrl+F jumps here.
fslog.view.search.note: Search only filters this view: the whole snapshot (%s messages) goes to the site.
